# `board`

Helper: `board({ rooms, from, to, hh, legend })` (alias `week`)  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `WeekStrip` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Rooms across the top, time down the left in a 56px column, booking blocks placed by start and length; optional buffer block and free-slot buttons.

## Variants

- Booking colour by service 0-3 (info, brand, success, warning)
- Buffer: dashed hatched block
- Free slot: dashed "Đặt lịch" button

## States

- Slot is a button; others static

## Tokens

surface, line, table-head, tile, info/brand/success/warning (booking colours), radius-tile, radius-field

## Do

- Show the service legend (the board adds it)
- Mark the 15 minute room preparation as a buffer

## Don't

- Do not use it outside scheduling

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Web-only. Hour height `hh`.

## Mobile (390)

One list per room.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

**web-only.** Rooms × time, bookings positioned by start/mins; `buf` (minutes) adds "· +15′ đệm" to the time line and a hatched "15′ chuẩn bị phòng" block; `slots` draw free time as dashed "Đặt lịch" buttons (label "Đặt lịch <phòng> <giờ>"). 390: one list per room
